description_en: Migrates the zone of a MongoDB instance
name: MigrateAvailableZone

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

If the network type of the instance is VPC, you must also specify the Vswitch parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

如果实例的网络类型为专有网络，您还需要传入Vswitch参数
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the destination zone.

The destination zone and the current zone of the instance are in the same region.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html operation to query zone IDs
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区ID。

迁移的目标可用区和当前实例的可用区处于同一地域。
您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/61933.html接口查询可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch in the destination zone.

This parameter is required when the network type of the instance is VPC
parameters.help_zh:
迁移的目标可用区虚拟交换机ID。

当实例的网络类型为专有网络时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: vswitch

parameters.help_en:
The effective time for migrating the zone. The instance must be active. Valid values:
Immediately: Takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: Takes effect during the maintenance window of the instance.

Default value: Immediately
parameters.help_zh:
迁移可用区的生效时间，取值：
Immediately：立即生效。
MaintainTime：在实例的可运维时间段内生效。

默认为Immediately
parameters.name: effective_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of destination secondary zone 1
parameters.help_zh: 迁移的目标备可用区1的ID
parameters.name: secondary_zone_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of destination secondary zone 2
parameters.help_zh: 迁移的目标备可用区2的ID
parameters.name: hidden_zone_id
